description: An enormous, pale green beast known for living in swamps and eating passersby, clutching a gigantic club in a single meaty hand; it will kill anything it gets its hands on.

special_attacks.hit_dmg_u: %1$s hits your %2$s with an enormous club!
special_attacks.miss_msg_u: %1$s tries to hit you, but you dodge!
special_attacks.miss_msg_npc: %1$s tries to hit <npcname>, but they dodge!
special_attacks.no_dmg_msg_u: %1$s hits your %2$s without penetrating your armor.

description: An enormous, blue beast known for living in swamps and eating passersby, slightly smaller than the other ogres you've seen.  This ogre has a more calculating look.  As it idly waves the hand not holding a club, you see sparkles trail through the air after its fingers.

special_attacks.hit_dmg_u: %1$s hits your %2$s with an enormous club!
special_attacks.miss_msg_u: %1$s tries to hit you, but you dodge!
special_attacks.miss_msg_npc: %1$s tries to hit <npcname>, but they dodge!
special_attacks.no_dmg_msg_u: %1$s hits your %2$s without penetrating your armor.

special_attacks.hit_dmg_u: %1$s rumbles words of magic and an eldritch bolt impacts your %2$s!
special_attacks.hit_dmg_npc: %1$s rumbles words of magic and an eldritch bolt impacts <npcname>'s %2$s!
special_attacks.miss_msg_u: %1$s rumbles words of magic and you narrowly avoid an eldritch bolt!
special_attacks.miss_msg_npc: %1$s rumbles words of magic and <npcname> narrowly avoids an eldritch bolt!
special_attacks.no_dmg_msg_u: %1$s rumbles words of magic and your %2$s is impacted by an eldritch bolt, but it does no damage.
special_attacks.no_dmg_msg_npc: %1$s rumbles words of magic and <npcname>'s %2$s is impacted by an eldritch bolt, but it does no damage.
